name: @tyda/string
description: String utilities for Tyda, a composable type-level programming toolkit for TypeScript.
author: Ge Gao (Snowflyt) <gaoge011022@gmail.com>

scripts.link-workspace: node -e "import * as fs from 'node:fs/promises'; import * as path from 'node:path'; import rootPackageJSON from '../../package.json' with { type: 'json' }; const workspaces = await Promise.all(rootPackageJSON.workspaces.filter((folder) => folder !== 'packages/tyda' && folder !== 'typroof-plugin').map((folder) => path.join('..', '..', folder, 'package.json')).map((pathname) => fs.readFile(pathname, 'utf-8').then((packageJSONString) => ({ pathname, ...JSON.parse(packageJSONString) })))); for (const workspacePackageJSON of [workspaces.find(({ name }) => name === '@tyda/str';)]) { if (!workspacePackageJSON.dependencies) continue; const { dependencies, pathname } = workspacePackageJSON; let updated = false; for (const dependencyName of Object.keys(dependencies)) { const dependencyPackageJSON = workspaces.find(({ name }) => name === dependencyName); if (!dependencyPackageJSON) continue; if (dependencies[dependencyName] === dependencyPackageJSON.version || dependencies[dependencyName] === `^${dependencyPackageJSON.version}`) continue; updated = true; workspacePackageJSON.dependencies[dependencyName] = '^' + dependencyPackageJSON.version; console.log('Updated `' + workspacePackageJSON.name + '`’s dependency `' + dependencyName + '` to `^' + dependencyPackageJSON.version + '`'); } if (updated) await fs.writeFile(pathname, JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(workspacePackageJSON).filter(([key]) => key !== 'pathname')), null, 2) + '\n', 'utf-8'); }"
